sloka: ततो धर्मे विनष्टे तु त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ।सदेवर्षिगणं सर्वं विनश्येत्तु न संशयः ।। ७.१०६.१० ॥
transliteration: tato dharme vinaṣṭe tu trailokyaṁ sacarācaram ।sadevarṣigaṇaṁ sarvaṁ vinaśyettu na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.106.10 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, if righteousness is destroyed, then without a doubt, all three worlds, including all moving and non-moving beings, along with the groups of gods and sages, would also be destroyed.
